name: Wakapi
param_style: GORM v1.31 + glebarez/sqlite: ? positional; struct conditions render as `table`.`col` = ?, IN ? expands per call, LIMIT bound as ?, Raw named args (@name) rewritten to ?
schema_source: GORM model tags (models/user.go, heartbeat.go, duration.go, summary.go, leaderboard.go) hand-translated to the DDL AutoMigrate emits on SQLite, plus migrations/20260722_sqlite_convert_time_to_integer.go (integer epoch-ms times, user_heartbeats_range view), 20261011 and 20260929 (index replacements)
data_scale: scale 1: 205 users (alice heavy: 80k heartbeats over 3 years, 190 projects, 26k WakaTime-imported; bob..erin 15k each; 200 light users, ~70 % of them idle for weeks), 200k heartbeats, 100k durations, ~5.5k daily summaries with ~58k summary_items (alice ~930 / ~9.5k, matching #974's ~10 items per summary), ~1.2k leaderboard_items; ~121 MB. Roughly 1/6 of the #983 / #974 reporters' heartbeat counts and 1/3 of their durations. --scale 4 multiplies heartbeats, durations and the light users (alice then has 320k heartbeats)
visibility_note: 4.5k stars; self-hosted WakaTime backend, SQLite is the default database (Docker image and binary)
interest_note: Activity chart issues one summaries + summary_items join per day for a year (371 x 2 statements); the pre-fix CROSS JOIN pinned a full summary_items scan per day. Project stats: GROUP BY then sum/min/max/row_number windows per project. Last-active users: max(time) per user over the whole heartbeats table through a derived table. Leaderboard: rank() over lower(key) partitions in a derived table filtered by rank.
reach_note: widely self-hosted developer tool (Docker pulls in the millions, hosted wakapi.dev); SQLite is the default driver

cpu_evidence.summary: One-year activity chart took 15-30 s on SQLite (Celeron N3450, 513k heartbeats, 301k durations, 3.2k summaries, 30k summary_items): ~730 statements per chart, each populateItems CROSS JOIN scanning all summary_items; fixed by INNER JOIN + idx_summary_item_summary (8-12 s after)

All-time summary filtered by project took ~30 s or timed out with 420k heartbeats (30k in the project); GORM log shows last-active-users 2.9 s, durations 742 ms, project stats 525 ms, summary items 237 ms
Periodic CPU spikes: latest-heartbeat-by-project (user_id + project IN, ORDER BY time desc LIMIT 1) took minutes on MySQL until idx_user_project_time; ~400 ms after
Server unresponsive and CPU spikes during the nightly aggregation: forced duration regeneration streams every user's heartbeats and re-inserts all durations
Summaries are aligned to server time; for users in other time zones the per-day chart lookups miss persisted summaries and recompute from durations
